items.title_kr: Macy's, 제100회 Thanksgiving Day Parade 개최 및 Holiday merchandise 출시 준비
items.title_en: Macy's prepares for 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade and Holiday merchandise
items.body_kr: Macy's가 100주년을 맞이하는 Thanksgiving Day Parade를 앞두고 관련 Holiday merchandise와 마케팅 준비에 돌입했습니다. 동사의 대규모 연말 event는 traffic 증가와 연계 category sell-through 확대를 견인하는 핵심 retail channel로 작용합니다.
items.body_en: Macy's is gearing up for its milestone 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade alongside major holiday merchandise drops. The large-scale year-end event serves as a crucial retail channel driving store traffic and category sell-through.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 증권가 긍정적 전망 속 분기 earnings 기대감 고조
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch sees rising quarterly earnings expectations amid positive analyst revisions
items.body_kr: As investment banks like UBS raise their price targets, Abercrombie & Fitch is widely expected to beat quarterly earnings forecasts. The brand's solid margin defense and steady consumer demand are driving strong performance across wholesale and e-commerce channels.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Walmart 등 주요 retail사와 Hallmark의 Disney Christmas Movie Collection 출시
items.title_en: Hallmark Disney Christmas Movie Collection launching at Kohl's, Walmart and more
items.body_kr: Hallmark가 Disney IP를 활용한 Christmas Movie Collection을 Kohl's와 Walmart 등 주요 retail 채널에 선보입니다. 연말 Holiday season을 겨냥한 이 exclusive merchandise 라인업은 매장 traffic 유입과 선물 category 매출 견인에 기여할 전망입니다.
items.body_en: Hallmark is launching its Disney Christmas Movie Collection across major retail channels including Kohl's and Walmart. This exclusive holiday merchandise lineup is expected to drive store traffic and boost gifting category sales.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, 최대 70% 할인 포함 조기 Black Friday sale 전격 공개
items.title_en: Kohl's reveals early Black Friday sale featuring up to 70% off discounts
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 연말 쇼핑 시즌을 선점하기 위해 최대 70% 할인 혜택을 담은 조기 Black Friday promotion을 발표했습니다. 공격적인 pricing 전략을 통해 초기 inventory 소진을 가속화하고 연말 대목 consumer demand를 선점하려는 의도입니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has announced an early Black Friday promotion featuring discounts of up to 70% to capture holiday shoppers ahead of the peak season. This aggressive pricing strategy aims to accelerate initial inventory clearance and secure early consumer demand.
